Text.Text: The pens are mine again, and the audit has the evidence it needs. Feed your beast before you celebrate. You've finished my Apex Bite trials. I have no further work for you here.
You need rank 50 in Beast Mastery before I can send you into the preserve. Train as a handler, then come back. I won't lose another beast to an unready keeper.

A keeper crew has taken over my preserve and falsified the pen count. Their tally is the first record I need to get control back. Defeat six Apex Bite Adepts in Dathomir, Tarn Jungle Preserve. Their defeat secures the Apex Bite Tarn Hunt Tally; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Jungle Landing. I'll give you the Dathomir Tarn Jungle Preserve Key when you accept. Complete all five trials to earn the right to train Apex Bite.

Here's the Dathomir Tarn Jungle Preserve Key. Use 'Tarn Jungle Preserve' in Dathomir, Tarnished Jungles. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Apex Bite Adepts, then return with the Apex Bite Tarn Hunt Tally.

Keeper crew, self-appointed. Feed the beasts on fear instead of feed, if you want my honest opinion. A scared animal bites first and asks never. Good for a killing floor. Terrible for a preserve I'm supposed to hand back in one piece.

One bite. Committed, no second try, no half-measures. That's the whole technique, done right. These adepts try it scared and rushed, which just means a lot of animals get hurt for nothing. Waste of good teeth.

Because when the surveyors finally show up to audit this place, they want numbers that add up. Six missing tallies is six questions I don't have good answers for. Bring it back and I've got one less hole in my paperwork and one less reason to lose this preserve for good.
Defeat six Apex Bite Adepts in Dathomir, Tarn Jungle Preserve. Their defeat secures the Apex Bite Tarn Hunt Tally; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Jungle Landing.
You've defeated six Apex Bite Adepts. Let me see the Apex Bite Tarn Hunt Tally.
That's the record I needed. We can account for the trails again. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the specialist trial when you're ready.

The specialists keep the beasts agitated with a scent mixture. Take that vial out of their hands. Defeat five Apex Bite Specialists in Dathomir, Tarn Jungle Preserve. Their defeat secures the Apex Bite Beast-Pen Scent Vial; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Jungle Landing.
Your key still grants access to Dathomir, Tarn Jungle Preserve. Defeat five Apex Bite Specialists to secure the Apex Bite Beast-Pen Scent Vial, then return to me.

Preserve scent-vials are supposed to calm a spooked animal, mark it as safe ground. Theirs does the opposite on purpose. Bring it back and I can prove what they've been feeding my beasts, which is exactly the kind of proof an audit wants.

An angry animal is a predictable animal, in a bad way. Charges the first thing that moves. Doesn't think, doesn't wait, doesn't choose. Easier to point at a target when there's nothing left in it but rage. Cruelty dressed up as training.

You don't. A furious animal swings wild and hopes. A true apex bite waits for the one committed opening and takes it clean. Rage burns hot and sloppy. Discipline waits and lands once. That's the whole difference, and it's the whole reason my preserve trained it right in the first place.
Defeat five Apex Bite Specialists in Dathomir, Tarn Jungle Preserve. Their defeat secures the Apex Bite Beast-Pen Scent Vial; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Jungle Landing.
You've defeated five Apex Bite Specialists. Let me see the Apex Bite Beast-Pen Scent Vial.
This belongs with the handlers who know how to use it. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the warden trial when you're ready.

The warden carries the alpha totem that backs the crew's claim to the pens. Recover it. Defeat the Apex Bite Warden in Dathomir, Tarn Jungle Preserve. Their defeat secures the Apex Bite Clawed Alpha Totem; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Jungle Landing. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Dathomir, Tarn Jungle Preserve, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Apex Bite Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. After the fight, return with the Apex Bite Clawed Alpha Totem.

Ran my breeding program once, before the keeper crew showed up and made him a better offer. Knows every animal in that bay by name still, which is exactly why he's dangerous. He's not guessing where the apex bite lands. He's certain.

Alpha totem's supposed to mark the top of a healthy line, the animal every other one in the pen learns from. He's carrying it cracked because he cracked the line itself the day he switched sides. Whole totem back in my hands, and I've got proof of exactly which line got corrupted and when.

Yes. I recommend two companions for the Apex Bite Warden fight. That's advice for a dangerous encounter, not an entry requirement. Gather your party before calling the challenge; a second pair of hands can keep a bad opening from ending the fight.

Defeat the Apex Bite Warden in Dathomir, Tarn Jungle Preserve. Their defeat secures the Apex Bite Clawed Alpha Totem; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Jungle Landing. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Apex Bite Warden. Let me see the Apex Bite Clawed Alpha Totem.
The totem is back in our keeping. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the inner circle trial when you're ready.

Four keepers still control the preserve's records and orders. Recover their token so I can dispute their claim. Defeat four members of the Apex Bite Inner Circle in Dathomir, Tarn Jungle Preserve. Their defeat secures the Apex Bite Preserve Keeper's Token; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Jungle Landing.
Your key still grants access to Dathomir, Tarn Jungle Preserve. Defeat four members of the Apex Bite Inner Circle to secure the Apex Bite Preserve Keeper's Token, then return to me.

The whole operation. Feed schedules, pen assignments, which animal gets which handler. Everything I used to run honestly, they run for profit and cruelty in equal measure. Cut off the head and the rest of this mess falls apart fast.

That token's the closest thing this preserve has to a deed. Whoever holds it can sign off on feed orders, pen transfers, all of it. They minted their own copies to make it look legal. One real token in my hand, and every signature they've made since gets thrown out.

Same way any bad operation runs smooth for a while: divide the work, keep everyone too busy to ask questions. One handles feed, one handles pens, one handles intake, one handles whoever asks too many questions. That's you now, apparently.
Defeat four members of the Apex Bite Inner Circle in Dathomir, Tarn Jungle Preserve. Their defeat secures the Apex Bite Preserve Keeper's Token; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Jungle Landing.
You've defeated four members of the Apex Bite Inner Circle. Let me see the Apex Bite Preserve Keeper's Token.
The keepers can no longer claim authority here. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the final trial when you're ready.

Their master is the last keeper standing between me and the pens. Defeat him and we'll finish your lesson. Defeat the Apex Bite Master in Dathomir, Alpha Beast Hollow. Report back to me here in Dathomir, Jungle Landing; no item is needed for this final trial. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Dathomir, Alpha Beast Hollow, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Apex Bite Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. Once the master is defeated, come back for the final lesson.

Everyone else's bite is a strike. His is a certainty. He's never once landed it wrong in all the years I've watched this preserve go bad, and that's not luck, that's the technique done exactly as it's meant to be done, aimed at people instead of prey. That's what you've been learning to do right this whole time. He's just been doing it wrong, expertly.

Yes. I recommend two companions for the Apex Bite Master fight. That's advice for a dangerous encounter, not an entry requirement. Gather your party before calling the challenge; a second pair of hands can keep a bad opening from ending the fight.

Goes back to being a preserve instead of a killing floor with a feed schedule. I'll have the pens right again inside a season, if the surveyors don't beat me to shutting the whole place down out of spite. Either way, that's my problem, not yours. Yours is finishing this.

Defeat the Apex Bite Master in Dathomir, Alpha Beast Hollow. Report back to me here in Dathomir, Jungle Landing; no item is needed for this final trial. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Apex Bite Master. Give me your report and we'll finish the trial.
The pens are mine again, and the audit has the evidence it needs. Feed your beast before you celebrate. You've earned the right to train Apex Bite. Your final payment is ready.
Back to the count.
I'll defeat six Apex Bite Adepts.
Who took over your pens?
What's an apex bite, exactly?
Why does this tally matter so much?
Not my problem yet.
Here's the Apex Bite Tarn Hunt Tally.
Back to the count.
I'll defeat five Apex Bite Specialists.
What's in the vial they're using?
Why keep the beasts angry on purpose?
How do you land a bite on something that's already furious?
Give me a day to think about it.
Here's the Apex Bite Beast-Pen Scent Vial.
Back to the count.
I'll defeat the Apex Bite Warden.
Who is this warden to your preserve?
What's the alpha totem, and why's the audit care?
Would you recommend bringing help?
Haven't got my two yet.
Here's the Apex Bite Clawed Alpha Totem.
Back to the count.
I'll defeat four members of the Apex Bite Inner Circle.
What does the inner circle actually run?
What's this keeper's token worth to your audit?
How do four keepers manage a whole preserve like this?
My two need a rest first.
Here's the Apex Bite Preserve Keeper's Token.
Back to the count.
I'll face the Apex Bite Master and report back.
How is his bite different from everyone else's?
Would you recommend bringing help?
What happens to the preserve, once he's gone?
Not till we're all ready.
The Apex Bite Master is defeated. Here's my report.
